data.content: Lesna Ndërtimi is a leading construction company known for its innovative and high-quality projects. We partnered with them to develop a strong brand identity and create a strategic social media presence
Our branding strategy for the residence client focused on a powerful palette of rich reds paired with complementary greys, creating a visual identity that’s both striking and contemporary.
The red symbolizes energy, passion, and the vibrant community the residence fosters, while the grey adds a sophisticated, grounded balance that exudes stability and reliability.
From logo design to digital assets, every detail of the branding captures the essence of modern living and appeals to residents seeking a stylish, welcoming space they can truly call home.
For our residence client, we developed a dynamic social media strategy centered on showcasing the full experience of their offerings.
Through stunning visuals of apartments, building exteriors, and lifestyle amenities, we highlighted the unique appeal of each property.
We complemented this with engaging animations and walkthroughs, bringing spaces to life across all platforms.
Our strategy extended to launching a new website and mobile app, giving prospective tenants a seamless digital experience and enhancing their journey from exploration to residence.
The residence’s website is designed to be smart, modern, and effortlessly user-friendly with sleek navigation, interactive elements of available apartments.
Every feature is optimized for an intuitive experience, making it simple for visitors to connect, inquire, and envision their next home.
The reimagined branding and cutting-edge website transformed their online presence, sparking a surge in visibility and engagement that established them as a standout contender in the housing market.
